brief:
Operation Al-Aqsa Flood did not arise in a vacuum but rather as a response to prolonged hardship, according to analysis circulated by Shehab Wire. The operation came as a forceful reaction to an intolerable reality shaped by more than two decades of conditions in Gaza Strip.

The framing positions the October operation within historical and temporal context rather than as an isolated event, emphasizing accumulated grievances over the extended period preceding the escalation.

title: Gaza's October uprising emerged from two decades of blockade, analysts say
